name: audio_generation
description: Generate audio through agent-gw: convert text to speech with a chosen voice, or create custom sound effects from an English description and a duration. Output is saved locally as mp3.
author: Moonshot AI
skillInstructions: Use the audio_generation skill when the user wants to generate audio. It has two flows: (1) text-to-speech — convert text to spoken audio using one of the supported voice IDs; and (2) sound effects — create a custom sound effect from an English description and a duration between 0.5 and 22 seconds. Pick the right flow from the user's intent, build the parameters, call the matching gateway API (generate_speech or generate_sound_effects), download the returned media URL to a local mp3, then surface the saved audio to the user. Do not fabricate audio or a local path when the call fails.

interface.shortDescription: Text-to-speech and AI sound effect generation
interface.longDescription: Generate audio in two ways: convert text to high-quality speech using a selected voice, or create custom sound effects from an English description and a duration (0.5 to 22 seconds). Speech supports several Mandarin voices; sound effects cover ambient, action, musical, foley, emotional, and abstract sounds. Results are saved locally as mp3 files.
